h1: Custom Tealight Candles for Branded Events
metaDescription: Order custom tealight candles for events. Perfect Imprints offers bulk branding on mini candles. Request a quote today!
introHtml: Tealight candles are a subtle but effective promotional product for events, hospitality suites, and corporate gifts. Their small size makes them easy to customize with a logo or message, and they fit neatly into gift bags or favor boxes. Unlike larger candles, tealights offer a low-cost, high-volume branding opportunity that guests can use at home, extending your brand’s visibility with each burn. Choose from scented or unscented options to match your event’s theme.
heroAltText: Custom tealight candles with branded labels in bulk packaging for corporate events
